intent: Individually teach awake as state not awakening; breathe verb and simultaneous slow action; sneeze after causative make; virus possibility and contact route; infection risk reduction without guarantees; bandage noun and two maintained properties; wheelchair space beside table without assuming dimensions.
picturePurpose: Four code-owned interactive scenes change state, overlap of time bars, bandage cleanliness/dryness and table-side clearance. Three exact evidence tasks distinguish possibility, cause and risk from completed events or guarantees. No fabricated biological or medical image is needed.
